name: Kolibri 1.1
context_scaling: config.json declares rope_theta 10000 and NO rope_scaling, with max_position_embeddings 262144. The card claims 262,144 native 'up to 1,048,576' and its own vLLM recipe reaches the longer window by passing --max-model-len 1048576 --hf-overrides '{"max_position_embeddings": 1048576}', i.e. a config override rather than a published scaling recipe. The card recommends staying at or below 262,144 for complex tasks.
attention_variant: Hybrid MLA with sparse indexing: 50 layers, 40 sliding_attention (window 513) and 10 indexed_attention (index_topk 2048 over an index_pool_size 16384 pool at 16x compression, plus 128 local and 8 sink tokens). kv_source_layers aliases six layers onto another layer's cache (9,14,49 -> 4; 34,39,44 -> 29), so 44 distinct caches exist and only the 4 that are indexed layers grow per token. MLA head geometry: 48 Q / 4 KV heads, head_dim 128, kv_lora_rank 512, qk_rope_head_dim 64. kv_cache_qat true.

notes:
ADDED 2026-11-25 from the trending sweep. Kolibri 1.1 is Aleph Alpha's successor to models/kolibri-1, not a fine-tune of the released Kolibri-1 instruct weights: the card says it continues training from a Kolibri 1 MID-TRAINING checkpoint (805B mid-training + 201B long-context tokens with sparse attention, then SFT/RL), and the architecture changed (sparse indexed attention added, model_type kolibri1_1), so it is recorded as its own base model rather than a derivative.

PARAMS: params_b 75.113 is HF safetensors.total 75,112,665,344. The card nameplate says 75,128,393,984 (75.128); the 15.7M difference is unexplained and the API number is used. active_params_b 3.44 is the card's own 3,439,874,304, not derived here. flops_per_token_active = 2 x 3.44e9 = 6.88e9 (schema 2N one-pass convention; the older 3N convention would give 10.3e9).

KV BASIS: 4,608 bytes/token = 4 growing caches x (kv_lora_rank 512 + qk_rope_head_dim 64) x 2 bytes (bf16). Only the indexed_attention layers whose source is themselves (4, 19, 24, 29) grow; the other six indexed layers read an earlier layer's cache via kv_source_layers, and the 40 sliding layers saturate at the 513-token window (40 x 1152 = 46,080 bytes resident, flat past 513 tokens). At the 262,144-token config context the growing part is 4608 x 262144 = 1.21 GB, versus 5.4 GB for models/kolibri-1 (20,480 B/token). NOTE: an MLA-vs-GQA caveat - config.json also declares num_key_value_heads 4, and a GQA reading would give 2,048 B/layer, so the 1,152 B/layer here follows the kv_lora_rank MLA formula the card's 'Gated MLA' language implies. If the serving stack caches full GQA K/V instead, the figure is 4 x 2048 = 8,192 B/token.

EVIDENCE: BEATS the catalog's previous best in the <=4.5B-active class on LiveCodeBench v6: 93.0 vs kolibri-1 85.9, and its own card's Kolibri-1.0 column is 85.4. Also beats the class best on miniF2F (31.5 vs kolibri-1 9.5) and on BenchCAD Code Edit (86.2 vs 52.2, card-only, no catalog comparator). LOSES in-class on GPQA Diamond (87.1 vs ornith-1-5-35b-a3b 89.2), AIME 2026 (95.8 vs aliceai-foundation-80b-a3b-base 96.7), AIME 2025 (98.3 vs maxwell-v1-flash 100.0), SWE-bench Verified (70.4 vs inkling-2-mini 79.2), Terminal-Bench 2.1 (35.6 vs ornith 67.8), IFBench (82.7 vs flint 89.2), BFCL v4 (62.7 vs qwen3-5-35b-a3b 67.3) and AA-LCR (71.0 vs sage-a1-5 81.0). Regressions against its own predecessor on Tau3-Bench Banking (28.6 vs 38.7) and Tau2 Telecom (93.0 vs 93.9) are recorded as rows.

HARDWARE GATE PASSED: 3.44B active, and the vendor's own Aleph-Alpha/Kolibri-1.1-GGUF repo ships IQ1_M-GSQ-RCO 1.75bpw at 15.44 GiB, IQ2_XXS-GSQ-RCO 2.00bpw at 17.64 GiB, Q3_K_M 33.50 GiB and Q4_K_M 42.38 GiB (sizes from the repo's own file listing, 2026-11-25), so the experts can sit in system RAM while the 3.44B active path stays on a small card. That is the whole reason this 75B model is worth recording for a low-VRAM box. FP8 checkpoint is ~77.6 GB and the card's minimum is 2xH100/1xB200, which does NOT fit this user's hardware; only the quant path does.

Vendor_claim on every row: no second source checked these numbers.
